g.text: BUILT A-01 / BLOCKOUT 05 / Existing footprint, revised interiors and doorway positions
A1 becomes reception, screening and staff rooms.
Opposing doorways move toward different corners.
A2 gets a longer entry deck and divided inspection bays.
Enter A3 below an upper walkway. Climb 4 m.
Follow the upper passage into A7 and take Records R.
Return downstairs to door 2. Card stays before its lock.
A4 splits into a lobby, dispatch and an exit vestibule.
Freight K sits on the approach before the routes divide.
BcD retains its separate ladder up to Maintenance.
Climb from A5 +2 m to a usable +6 m watch floor.
Cross an upper dogleg into A6, then descend 6 m
through the office block to the hub return.
Door offsets and partitions interrupt through-views.
Keep the existing branch junctions and return gate S1.
A8 stays optional; B and its progression are unchanged.
ROUTE HEIGHTS / metres above the hub
Mint: lower route / Purple: upstairs route
Gold stair arrows point UP; footprints are to scale.
R = Records card K = freight card S = selector
Separate detail sheets show each floor without overlap.
Reviewed A-01 interiors are built in blockout 05. Walk the revised spaces before the enemy and supply pass.
